absences.note: No enforced ordering or priority of pending sessions at any snapshot. S2+ have only admin worklists defined in canto.yaml (sessions_needing_approval from 2012-01-27, sessions_with_term_requests 2012-06-09, high_priority_publications) and a curation_priority field on papers set at triage (2012-01-30); counted true only in this weak worklist sense. S1 has only the paper triage queue (K36), nothing for sessions. Daily summary e-mail to admins (script/canto_daily.pl, 2013-06-12, S2+) lists newly submitted sessions and term requests; it changes no state.

S1: submitter just self-identifies; no assignment field or logic. S2+: curs_curator assignment table, admin create/reassign session (K32; any logged-in user in S2/S3), admin send-link (K33), in-session reassignment by curator (K34), exported guard (K35). No due dates and no automatic reminders at any snapshot; 'reminder' e-mails (session_resent template, 2013-11-20) are sent manually by admins and only record link_sent_to_curator_date, no state change.

No expiry, timeout, withdrawal timer or scheduled script writing session state at any snapshot (searched remind/expir/deadline/cron; script/ and etc/ only contain manual maintenance, export and daily summary scripts; etc/update_statuses.pl only recomputes cached statuses). S2+: admin-only session deletion (K37); S2/S3 exported sessions frozen (K26). Curator pause (K4) is not an exit. S1: only the generic Delete controller (any logged-in user can delete DB objects) - treated as generic infrastructure.

notes: S1 (v243, PomCur) predates the review workflow entirely: states were only NEEDS_SUBMITTER/NEEDS_GENES/READY; the NEEDS_APPROVAL/APPROVAL_IN_PROGRESS/APPROVED/EXPORTED machine arrived 2012-01-21..2012-02-14. State-transition precondition checks in State.pm::set_state were croak()s from 2012-02-03 to 2012-07-25 (commit 7e5e9807b) and have been carp() warnings since, so they are not recorded as guards at S2-S4; only the admin checks and (S2/S3) the EXPORTED freeze croak. Dates are author dates of the first commit found with git log -S over both lib/PomCur and lib/Canto paths (rename 2013-10-13); all were checked for ancestry against the snapshot tags. Exception: K32 author date 2016-10-13 is misleading; the commit entered mainline 2023-03-15. Security observations at S4: ws/ write endpoints are reachable for submitted/approved/exported sessions (K3 weakened), cancel_approval and set_exported_state have no explicit admin check (cancel relies on APPROVAL_IN_PROGRESS routing; set_exported_state is whitelisted for APPROVED sessions for any link holder); reactivate_session is open to any link holder in NEEDS_APPROVAL/APPROVED. annotation_delete_suggestion route exists (2012-10-19) but no template links to it at S4 and it has no role check; not recorded. K14 and K11 are borderline (contribution attribution/capability rather than review).
